action.title: Identifies if a record is to be upserted (inserted or updated) or (hard) deleted.

id.description: The unique identifier for an access token record.

key.title: Stores the access tokens for a user and developer tools.
key.description:
This table in Canvas Data 2 will only share developer tool specific token metadata. All users have an option to
create an access token based on their role and level of data access.

developer_key_id.description: The unique identifier of a developer key.

user_id.description: The unique ID of the user the token acts as.

real_user_id.description: If the token was created while masquerading, this is the real user doing the masquerading. Used for auditing.

last_used_at.description: Timestamp of last access using this access token.

expires_at.description: The expiration date/time for this token. This may be a NULL value.

purpose.description: For user-generated tokens, purpose can be manually set. For app-generated tokens, this should be generated based on the scope defined in the authentication process.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when an `access_tokens` record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when an `access_tokens` record was updated.

scopes.description: A list of scopes that can be applied to access tokens. i.e.: courses.

workflow_state.description: The current state of the access token record.

value.title: Stores the access tokens for a user and developer tools.
value.description:
This table in Canvas Data 2 will only share developer tool specific token metadata. All users have an option to
create an access token based on their role and level of data access.
